package.display_name: Melusina P0 house - PCG fill layer

authority.route: POITOU P0 Golden Walk house leg (M00-M05)
authority.dressing_contract: specs/p0/melusina_house_p0_dressing.v1.json (97 placements: 68 base meshes + 10 functional Blueprints + 19 Enchanted Interiors props)
authority.prop_source: /Game/EnchantedInteriors - Kitbash3D Enchanted Interiors, converted onto M_Master_Toon_Universal on 2026-10-21; 284 prop meshes and 80 converted instances are available to the fill
authority.pcg_precedent: the Poitou World Compiler already emits per-zone grayscale density heatmaps plus a dressing_table.json (species -> mesh, per-band MI path, packer attributes); the house fill uses the same table shape and the same exclusion convention
authority.note: This contract covers ONLY the scatter layer. It never moves a hand-placed dressing actor and it never touches the Houdini room shell.

layer_split.houdini: melodia::room_shell (Content/HDA/MelodiaRoomShell_1.0.hda) owns the shell, the openings, the bead swags, the chair rail, the skirting and the floor medallion - 33 parameters, already procedural
layer_split.contract: specs/p0/melusina_house_p0_dressing.v1.json owns the 97 hand-placed placements: the hero props and everything that must CONTACT a surface (desk top 82, shelf top 186/250, console top 88, sitting table 79, bedside 77, chandelier bottom 200)
layer_split.pcg: THIS CONTRACT: the fill - books, candles, jars, bowls, cloth - placed by density, with no contact requirement
layer_split.why_pcg_does_not_replace_the_contract: PCG spawns on a surface without correcting the mesh pivot, so a desk-top or shelf-top prop would float or sink; the fill is therefore limited to scatter whose placement tolerance is looser than a contact

meter.note: the fill snaps to the same 0.6 m module as the house; a bay is one 4/4 bar at 128 BPM

bedroom.volume: the bedroom shell interior, x [-1150,-450], y [-995,-100], z 0
bedroom.density_texture: dressing_heatmap_bedroom.png (grayscale, white = maximum; authored like the Poitou zone heatmaps)

species.surface: west shelf run top (250 cm) and north shelves (186 cm)
species.rotation: aligned to the shelf run, 4 orientations
species.note: scholar's clutter breaking the clean system (rooms doc SS2)

species.surface: desk top (82 cm), bedside table (77 cm), chest (71 cm)
species.note: the warm layer; one warm light source FAMILY per room (candles OR lanterns OR chandelier)

bedroom.fill_budget: no more than 3 fill species legible in any one frame

landing.volume: the landing interior, x [-450,60], y [-995,-100], z 0
landing.fill_budget: the landing is a threshold, not a room - keep it sparse

salon.volume: the oval salon interior, x [60,1350], y [-1780,0], z 0

species.surface: the north-wall bookcase top (104 cm) and the floor beside it
species.note: Melusina's library reaches into the salon (rooms doc SS1)

species.surface: console table (88 cm), sitting table (79 cm)
sitting table (79 cm), console table (88 cm)

salon.fill_budget: the M04 landmark (the circular medallion and its five concentric rings) must stay legible: the fill keeps out of the medallion footprint

shared: PCGVolume per room, carrying a PCGDensityData asset (the old density volume is deprecated in UE 5.8)
one PCG graph per room, or one graph with three room subgraphs
the fill graph is a SUBGRAPH of the room shell's own PCGEx graph, so it inherits the shell bounds instead of guessing them
node_chain: PCGExShapeBoundsSource (or the shell's own bounds source) -> the room's surfaces
Surface Sampler on the named surfaces (shelf tops, table tops, console tops) for contact-free scatter; Grid Sampler on the 0.6 m module for floor fill
Density Filter: room density texture x the per-species weight above
Static Mesh Spawner per species: mesh, material (the converted instance, or an override), density, rotation rule
Mesh Bounds Overlap: kill prop-on-prop and prop-through-wall
Bounds Modifier / attribute exclusion: the route spline and its 4 m buffer, the door swing, the medallion footprint
optional: Attribute Filter on the exclusion spline (PCGEx spline filters)
pcg_graph.exclusion_source: BP_PathSplineProvider in the house level is the route spline; bake it into the density texture the way Poitou bakes its route path and 4 m buffer to zero, or use PCGEx's spline filters
pcg_graph.preview: the PCG editor preview shows the spawn live, so the density texture is painted while the room is visible

density_textures.derivation: the artist's own 97 placements, splatted with a 12 m kernel so grouped furniture becomes a density REGION rather than isolated specks, then the P0 route corridor cut back 4 m; normalised so the peak is white, gamma 0.7
density_textures.route_used: M00 Explore_Desk -> M01 MelodyToken_Heart -> M02 BP_CandleFlame -> M03 BP_Lantern -> M04 BP_Crystal -> M05 BP_HiddenDoor (the golden-walk beat order, reconstructed from the carriers the artist placed)
density_textures.what_it_is: a first pass that agrees with the artist's own composition: density gathers where the furniture is, and the walk corridor stays clear
density_textures.what_is_still_the_artist_s: the field is painted by hand in the end - this only saves starting from black. The route polyline here is reconstructed from carrier positions, not read from BP_PathSplineProvider, so the graph's own spline filter remains the authoritative exclusion

exclusions: the route from the bed to the front door, plus a 4 m buffer (P0 score: the walk must never snag furniture)
the M04 medallion footprint and the five concentric rings
every hand-placed dressing actor's bounds - the fill never crowds a contract placement
walls and the door swing (Bounds Modifier)
the stair run and the stair newels (the grand staircase is framed, not walkable)
rules: fill is additive: it may add actors, never move or delete a contract placement
no more than 3 fill species legible in any one frame (the style contract's four-layer analogue)
cute accents stay under 5% of any frame; pearl plaster and warm wood carry the room
everything the fill spawns uses the converted M_Master_Toon_Universal instances; the kit's own materials never re-enter
the fill never competes with a light source family: one family per room, chosen in the contract
snap to the 0.6 m module; a prop never lands on a wall or in a door swing
not_yet_true: no PCG node in this contract has been built yet - it is a design contract and certifies nothing until the graph runs and the room is photographed
the density textures exist as a DERIVED first pass (see density_textures) and still need the artist's paint; they are not the authored field
the surface samplers need the shell's PCGEx graph to expose the named surfaces (shelf tops, table tops) as scene proxies
the fill is additive to the 97-placement dressing contract; if that contract changes, the fill's counts and densities need a pass
the Enchanted Interiors pack has never been lit inside this house - the fill's look is unproven until the room is seen with the toon master
